title: Pointwise Convergence Analysis for Approximations of Optimal Transport Problems with a Target Measure that Has Unbounded Support
summary: We consider the Monge problem of optimal transport between a compactly supported source measure and a target probability measure with unbounded support. We consider the convergence of optimal maps and potential functions when the target measure is approximated, with special attention given to a cutoff approximation in which we parametrize the approximation by a ``cutoff" radius $R$ for the target measure.
